rule: The onboarding is a numbered state machine (69 named states, 0 to 670) held as data in tutorial.constant. Each step is a state gate (at a door or NPC), a text proc that writes up to four-line pages and sets a hint, a side-tab flash, and an advance on an event (talk, click, kill, cast). The first fight is a rigged NPC: tiny hit points, defence penalties far below zero on the three melee types, and zero damage when the player is at one hit point (the rat's attack routine tests the player's hit points before rolling). The rat's death queues the step advance. XP during the tutorial is granted only while the base level is below 3. Completion grants 18 starter items and 25 bank coins. The level-up ceremony is a per-row message with a fireworks spotanim, a jingle (a second jingle and dialog when the new level is in the skill's unlock set) and a pause button.
keep: Tutorial as a numbered state machine held as data, not code paths
One flashing tab icon at a time, plus a hint arrow over the next target
Four-line text pages with a continue button
Locked door with a one-line reason instead of silence
Rigged first fight: one enemy, tiny hit points, defence penalty, no damage at one hit point
XP cap during onboarding so the start does not overshoot
Starter kit granted at the end of onboarding
Level-up ceremony with message, fireworks, jingle and an unlock dialog for milestone levels
One-time skip offer at the guide
Mainland yes or no offer as the closing choice
change: Side-tab gate: pass the tab id into the trigger and advance only when it matches the flashing tab (donor advances on any tab 0 to 13)
Unhandled state: fall back to the nearest earlier state and log it, not a dead-end message
Text box sized for 375 wide (donor interface title box is 480 px)
Skip offer moved after the first win so the player sees the fight first
Rig lives in engine data for the onboarding zone (src/fight/<module>.ts; module to be picked by Lead)
look_test: Five minutes on Dom's phone, three runs: (A) donor-style 4-line box with a flashing tab that stays until opened; (B) one-line coach mark on the tab plus a hint arrow over the target; (C) the first fight with rig on versus off. Compare: is the flashing icon found within 3 seconds; does the fight read as won by skill.
licence_note: Code is MIT (LICENSE line 1; README line 62): code constants and logic may be adapted under MIT, so donor values are given only for code-level constants (XP cap level, damage floor, page width and lines). Game-derived data (NPC configs, state tables, texts, unlock lists, item and stat numbers) has unknown provenance and rights, so its donor values are null and inspiration is category-level only. Texts are paraphrased; no dialogue quoted beyond short titles. No legal conclusions.
